notes: Peckham works with local schools and state job help offices. Ask if placements are paid.
name: Peckham Youth Services and school work-based learning
what_you_do: Get job training, job coaching and a career plan of your own. Students try work at local employers through partner schools. Peckham serves youth with disabilities and youth with court records.
who_can_apply: Youth and young adults who have trouble finding work. This includes those with disabilities or court records. Embers is for girls ages 12 to 17 who have lived through trauma. Other age limits are not listed.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the page. Use the Contact Us page on peckham.org. You can also ask your school or job help counselor.
